How it works

STEP 1 - DESIGN PREVIEW

You send a photo of your room. We design the wall around your space, screen and equipment, and send back a concept with a written estimate.

STEP 2 - MATERIALS & SCHEDULE

You approve the design and materials. We order everything and schedule the build days - most materials are prepared before we arrive.

STEP 3 - BUILD

Our crew builds the wall in layers: framing, finish, cabinetry, lighting and equipment. The room is protected and the site is cleaned daily.

STEP 4 - WALKTHROUGH

We mount and connect the equipment, test lighting and remotes with you, and walk every seam and edge together before final payment.

Why homeowners pick a built wall over a bigger TV stand

A media wall is designed to the inch: the screen at the right height, equipment hidden but ventilated, cables gone, and storage where you actually need it. The wall reads as furniture - the most finished surface in the room - instead of a TV sitting in front of drywall. Add walnut slats for warmth, stone for weight, or a linear fireplace for the evenings, and the room is done.

Every project starts the same way: your room photo, our design, a written number. See what media walls cost or how the process runs.

The price in your written estimate is the price you pay. The scope is itemized line by line, and the number does not change after the build starts unless you change the scope.

Common questions

How much does a media wall cost in Los Angeles?

TV accent walls start at $2,500, full custom media walls at $7,500, and stone and marble feature walls at $9,800. Your exact number comes as a written estimate after a free design preview - send a photo of your room through the form and we design your wall first.

How does the free design preview work?

Send a photo of your room through any form on this site. We design the wall for your space - layout, materials, lighting - and reply with the concept and a written estimate range. No visit, no obligation.

How long does installation take?

Most media walls take 3 to 5 working days on site once materials are ready. Single accent walls often finish in 1 to 3 days. Design and ordering happen before the build, so your room is a work zone for days, not weeks.

Which areas do you serve?

Los Angeles and surrounding cities within roughly 40 miles - from Malibu and Santa Monica to Pasadena, the San Gabriel Valley, Orange County and the South Bay. See the full list on the service areas page.
